name: Saint Kitts
summary: An island divided between English and French colonists before repeated conquests.
notes: The shared lane means separately administered English and French zones, not a peaceful condominium. The Knights of Malta administered only the French zone in 1651–1666; this is an annotation to the shared track.

events.title: Spain claims the island
events.detail: Columbus sighted the island; no Spanish colony followed.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: English settlement established
events.detail: Thomas Warner’s colonists established an English foothold.

events.title: French colonists join the English
events.detail: French and English colonies developed in different parts of the island.

events.title: Kalinago people massacred
events.detail: English and French colonists attacked Kalinago inhabitants, violently consolidating their footholds.

events.title: A Spanish expedition takes the colonies
events.detail: Spain expelled or dispersed English and French colonists.

events.title: English and French settlement resumes
events.detail: The divided colonial arrangement was restored after Spanish withdrawal.

events.title: The French zone passes to the Knights
events.detail: The Order of Saint John acquired proprietary administration of the French colony under French sovereignty.

events.title: France takes the English zone
events.detail: French forces secured control of the whole colonial island.

events.title: Partition restored after Breda
events.detail: The 1667 treaty’s restoration of the English zone was implemented in 1671.

events.title: France occupies the whole island
events.detail: The Nine Years’ War disrupted the partition again.

events.title: English forces conquer both zones
events.detail: An English expedition displaced French control.

events.title: The French zone restored
events.detail: The Treaty of Ryswick’s terms were implemented.

events.title: England takes the French colony
events.detail: The War of the Spanish Succession brought another conquest.

events.title: French troops raid Saint Kitts
events.detail: A brief invasion pillaged the island without a lasting new administration.

events.title: Utrecht ends the partition
events.detail: France ceded its part to Britain.

events.title: Brimstone Hill falls
events.detail: French forces captured Saint Kitts in the American Revolutionary War.

events.title: The peace returns the island
events.detail: Saint Kitts was restored to Britain.
